name: Code Review & Pull Request Governance
description: Code Review & Pull Request Governance standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-CODE-REVIEW applies.

rules.title: Require review before protected-branch merge
rules.detail: Changes to protected branches require at least one qualified reviewer and all mandatory automated checks to pass.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Require review before protected-branch merge.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Require review before protected-branch merge.

rules.title: Review correctness, security, tests and operability—not formatting alone
rules.detail: Reviewers must assess requirement/AC coverage, failure paths, authorization, sensitive data, concurrency, observability and rollback impact where applicable.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Review correctness, security, tests and operability—not formatting alone.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Review correctness, security, tests and operability—not formatting alone.

rules.title: Keep pull requests reviewable and traceable
rules.detail: PRs should be scoped to one coherent change, reference the requirement/feature/bug, explain risky decisions and identify migration or deployment impact.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Keep pull requests reviewable and traceable.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Keep pull requests reviewable and traceable.

rules.title: Resolve review comments explicitly
rules.detail: Blocking comments must be addressed or dispositioned with rationale before merge; silent ignore is not acceptable.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Resolve review comments explicitly.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Resolve review comments explicitly.

rules.title: Prevent self-approval for high-risk changes
rules.detail: Security, payment, identity, data migration and production-infrastructure changes require an independent reviewer.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Prevent self-approval for high-risk changes.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Prevent self-approval for high-risk changes.

rules.title: Use review evidence as a quality gate
rules.detail: Record approvals, check results and exceptions so the review can be audited later.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Use review evidence as a quality gate.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Use review evidence as a quality gate.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-CODE-REVIEW applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Code Review & Pull Request Governance to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Code Review & Pull Request Governance is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Code Review & Pull Request Governance failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
